title: Ukudibanisa imfuyo emincinci
description: Iinkukhu, iidada neenyosi njengamalungu enkqubo — hayi izinto ezicingwa emva kwexesha.

lessons.title: Iinkukhu kwinkqubo: ukulawula izinambuzane, ukutyebisa umhlaba nokutya
lessons.body:
Iinkukhu zinokunceda kwibhedi engenanto emva kokuvuna. Zikrwela phakathi kwentsalela yezityalo zize zitye ezinye izinambuzane nembewu yokhula. Ubulongwe bazo nezinto zokulala zazo zinokwenziwa umgquba zibuyiselwe emhlabeni. Ukuzifunela ukutya akuyithatheli indawo ukutya okunesondlo ngokufanelekileyo, amanzi acocekileyo, indawo yokukhosela nokukhathalelwa yonke imihla.

I-chicken tractor yikhola eshukumayo, engenaphantsi (ikhola yeenkukhu enokuhanjiswa). Yishukumise ngaphambi kokuba umhlaba ungabi nasityalo, ube yodaka okanye ugutyungelwe kakhulu bubulongwe. Ixesha elifanelekileyo lixhomekeke kwiinkukhu, kumhlaba nakwimozulu. Akukho nani linye leenkukhu eliqinisekisa ukuba kuya kubakho ukutyeba komhlaba okwaneleyo kuyo yonke isiza.

Gcina iinkukhu kude nezithombo nakwizityalo ezivunelwa ukutya. Ubulongwe obutsha bunokuba neentsholongwane. Cela umcebisi wezolimo akuxelele indlela yokujongana nobulongwe ngokukhuselekileyo ngaphambi kokutyala isityalo esilandelayo. Iidada zikrwela kancinci, kodwa zisenokonakalisa izityalo zenze umhlaba omanzi ube yodaka. Bukela iintaka uzishukumise xa kuyimfuneko.
keyPoints: Shukumisa ikhola ngaphambi kokuba iintaka zonakalise umhlaba okanye ubulongwe bubuthelane
Lungelelanisa inani leentaka nokusetyenziswa kobulongwe nomhlaba wakho, izityalo zakho nokutya okukhoyo
Faka iinkukhu kwibhedi emva kokuvuna kuphela — ungaze uzifake kufuphi nezithombo ezincinci
Iidada zikrwela kancinci, kodwa zisafuna ukubekwa esweni xa zikufuphi nezityalo nomhlaba omanzi

quiz.q: Ufuna iinkukhu zilungiselele ibhedi engenanto ukuze ityalwe kwakhona. Lixesha elifanelekileyo nini ukuzifaka?
options: Kwangoko emva kokutyala izithombo, ukuze zikhulule umhlaba ojikeleze zona
Emva kokuvuna, ibhedi sele icociwe, ngaphambi kokutyala okulandelayo
Ngexesha lokukhula, xa amagqabi aphezulu esenokumelana nokukrwelwa
Ebusika kuphela ukuze kuthintelwe uxinezeleko lobushushu
quiz.rationale: Sebenzisa ibhedi engenanto emva kokuvuna. Gcina ubulongwe obutsha kude nezityalo zokutya kwaye ucwangcise indlela ekhuselekileyo yokujongana nobulongwe ngaphambi kokutyala kwakhona.

quiz.q: Kutheni iidada zifaneleke ngakumbi kunokuba kunjalo ngeenkukhu kumgangatho ongezantsi wehlathi lokutya elimileyo (food forest understorey)?
options: Iidada zivelisa ubulongwe obuninzi ngosuku
Iidada zitya ii-slug nee-snail ngaphandle kokukrwela okunamandla okuphazamisa iingcambu nengca yokugquma
Iidada azinakugula sisifo i-Newcastle
Iidada zilala emithini, nto leyo ehlisa ukuqina komhlaba
quiz.rationale: Iidada azikrweli njengeenkukhu. Zisenokunyathela okanye zitye izityalo, ngoko jonga umhlaba uzishukumise xa kuyimfuneko.

lessons.infographicAlt: Umzobo wekhola yeenkukhu enamavili ibonakaliswe kwiindawo ezimbini ecaleni komtya womhlaba. Utolo lukhomba ngasekunene; iinkukhu ezintathu zimi ekholeni ekunene, kwaye kukho indawo ekrwelwe ngokumnyama phakathi kweendawo ezimbini.

lessons.title: Iinyosi: ukungenisa umgubo, ubusi nobudlelwane bendalo enkqubeni
lessons.body:
Iinyosi zobusi nezinye izinambuzane zithwala umgubo wezintyatyambo ziwuse kwezinye iintyatyambo. Oku kunceda izityalo ezininzi zeziqhamo nemifuno, kuquka i-avocado. Izityalo neentlobo ezahlukeneyo ziyahluka ngezinto ezizidingayo ekungeniseni umgubo. Umzi wenyosi awuqinisekisi isivuno esingcono kuyo yonke indawo: imozulu, amanzi, impilo yezityalo nezinye izinambuzane ezisasaza umgubo nazo ziyabalulekile.

UMzantsi Afrika uneentlobo ezincinci (subspecies) ezimbini zeenyosi zobusi zemveli. Inyosi yobusi yaseKapa (Cape honeybee) ifumaneka eNtshona Koloni nakwezinye iindawo zeMpuma Koloni. Inyosi yobusi yase-Afrika (African honeybee) yeyemveli kwi-Afrika ephakathi nakubuninzi boMzantsi weAfrika. Ezi ndawo zendalo ngokubanzi aziyondlela yokukhokela ekuhambiseni iinyosi. Amanyathelo okulawula eSebe amisela umgca wokohlula ngokuhamba kweenyosi. Jonga imithetho yangoku yokuhambisa iinyosi kwiSebe nakumgcini weenyosi onamava wasekuhlaleni ngaphambi kokuhambisa iinyosi okanye imizi yeenyosi.

Funda kumgcini weenyosi onamava wasekuhlaleni ngaphambi kokufumana umzi wenyosi. Gcina imizi yeenyosi kude neendlela ezixineneyo, amakhaya neendawo apho abantwana badlala khona. Ilanga lasekuseni linokunceda; indawo ekhuselekileyo ibalulekile kuqala. Nika iinyosi izityalo ezinentyatyambo ngamaxesha onke onyaka kwaye uphephe ukuveza iinyosi kumachiza okubulala izinambuzane. Iinyosi ezisebenzayo aziyongqina lokuba ifama ayinamachiza okanye izifo. Amanyathelo kazwelonke okulawula iinyosi zobusi afuna ukubhaliswa kwimisebenzi echaziweyo yokugcina iinyosi, kuquka imizi yeenyosi elawulwayo yeemveliso zeenyosi, ukukhulisa ookumkanikazi, ukungenisa umgubo ngokurhweba, nokususwa, ukutshatyalaliswa okanye ukuhanjiswa kweqela leenyosi. Buza kwiSebe ukuba awuqinisekanga ukuba imithetho iyasebenza na kumsebenzi wakho. Ukuba iqela leenyosi liphuma ngamaqela ngokuphindaphindiweyo, cela umgcini weenyosi oqeqeshiweyo alihlole. Ukuxinana sesinye sezizathu ezinokubakho, akukuko ukuxilongwa kwengxaki.
keyPoints: Izinambuzane ezisasaza umgubo zinceda izityalo ezininzi; inzuzo ixhomekeke kwisityalo nakwimeko
Funda indlela ekhuselekileyo yokukhathalela umzi wenyosi kumgcini weenyosi onamava wasekuhlaleni
Khetha indawo ekhuselekileyo yomzi wenyosi, kude neendlela ezixineneyo nabantwana
Bhalisa kwiSebe kwimisebenzi egubungelwe ngamanyathelo kazwelonke okulawula iinyosi zobusi

quiz.q: Imithi ye-avocado iyatyatyamba kodwa ivelisa iziqhamo ezimbalwa. Umfama kufuneka ahlole ntoni ngokungenisa umgubo?
options: Cinga ukuba ukungenisa umgubo kuhlala kwanele kwaye ungahloli nto
Cinga ukuba yinye kuphela intlobo yebhungane enokuthwala umgubo
Hlola ukuba izinambuzane ziyazityelela na iintyatyambo zize zithwale umgubo; ezinye izizathu zokuvela kweziqhamo ezimbalwa nazo kufuneka zihlolwe
Cinga ukuba ukuvela kweziqhamo ezimbalwa kuhlala kuthetha umonakalo weqabaka
quiz.rationale: Iinyosi nezinye izinambuzane zinokuhambisa umgubo phakathi kweentyatyambo ze-avocado. Utyelelo oluncinci lunokunciphisa ukungenisa umgubo, kodwa imozulu nemeko yesityalo nazo zinokuchaphazela ukuvela kweziqhamo.

quiz.q: Iinyosi zomzi wenyosi ziphume ngamaqela ngokuphindaphindiweyo. Leliphi inyathelo elilandelayo elilunge kakhulu?
options: Cela umgcini weenyosi oqeqeshiweyo ahlole iqela leenyosi, kuquka isithuba, ukumkanikazi nempilo
Tshintsha ukumkanikazi ungahlolanga iqela leenyosi
Cinga ukuba akukho nto inokuhlolwa okanye ilawulwe
Jikisa umzi wenyosi ungafumananga sizathu
quiz.rationale: Ukuxinana kunokukhuthaza iinyosi ukuba ziphume ngamaqela, kodwa asisiso sodwa isizathu. Uhlolo lukhokela impendulo; ukongeza isithuba asiyonyango eqinisekileyo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Umzi wenyosi uvuliwe ubonisa iifreyimu ezibekwe phezu komnye ngaphakathi, nesangqa esibanzi phezu kwemephu yefama sibonisa ukuba iinyosi ziya kude kangakanani ukuzifunela ukutya.

lessons.title: Ukudibanisa imijikelo yemfuyo: izondlo ezihamba kwifama
lessons.body:
Ezinye izondlo zinokubuyela kwindawo yokutyala kumgquba owenziwe ngobulongwe. Ubulongwe obutsha bunokuba neentsholongwane eziyingozi. Vundisa ubulongwe ngokupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuba ubusebenzise kufuphi nezityalo zokutya. Ukutya okuthengiweyo kungenisa izondlo kwifama, ngoxa ukutya nezinye iimveliso kuzisusa. Gcina irekhodi yokutya okuthengiweyo nokutya okuthengisiweyo okanye okuthathelwe ekhaya. Intsalela yokutya yodwa isenokunganeli iimfuno zezilwanyana.

I-guinea fowl zizifunela izinambuzane kwaye zisenokutya ii-tick (izilwanyana ezincinci ezifunxa igazi). Musa ukuzithemba ukukhusela abantu okanye imfuyo kwii-tick okanye kwizifo ezithwalwa zii-tick. Hlola izilwanyana kwaye ulandele isicwangciso sasekuhlaleni sempilo yezilwanyana.

Kwisilwanyana ngasinye, buza: sinokutya ntoni apha? Zeziphi izinto eziluncedo esizivelisayo? Sidinga ntoni enye? Dibanisa amanzi, ukutya okufanelekileyo, indawo yokukhosela, uthango nokukhathalelwa yonke imihla.

Ukulandela kweenkukhu iibhokhwe akuyondlela eqinisekisiweyo yokuthatha indawo yokulawula iintshulube zeebhokhwe. Ulawulo lokulisa lunokunceda, kodwa iibhokhwe zisadinga uhlolo lwempilo nesicwangciso se-parasite (izilwanyana ezihlala kwezinye) esivela kugqirha wezilwanyana okanye kumcebisi wempilo yezilwanyana. Musa ukumisa unyango ngenxa yokuba iinkukhu zityelele inkampu yokulisa.
keyPoints: Sebenzisa izixhobo zefama ezifanelekileyo ngoxa uhlangabezana neemfuno ezipheleleyo zesilwanyana ngasinye
Ukuzifunela kwe-guinea fowl akuthathi ndawo yohlolo lwee-tick okanye isicwangciso sempilo yezilwanyana
Buza ukuba isilwanyana ngasinye sitya ntoni, sivelisa ntoni, sidinga ntoni, kuquka nezinto ezithengiweyo
Musa ukuthatha indawo yolawulo lweentshulube zeebhokhwe ngeenkukhu ezilandela umhlambi

quiz.q: Umfama ugcina i-guinea fowl. Kufuneka alawule njani ii-tick kwimfuyo yakhe?
options: Yeka ukuhlola imfuyo ngenxa yokuba kukho iintaka
Qhubeka uhlola izilwanyana kwaye ulandele isicwangciso sasekuhlaleni sempilo yezilwanyana
Cinga ukuba iidada ziyazisusa zonke ii-tick
Phatha zonke izilwanyana ngaphandle kokuhlola ingxaki okanye ukufumana icebiso
quiz.rationale: Iintaka zisenokutya ii-tick, kodwa oko akusiqinisekisi ukhuseleko oluthembekileyo kwii-tick okanye kwizifo ezizithwalayo.

quiz.q: Iinkukhu zizifunele ukutya emva kweebhokhwe. Umfama kufuneka enze ntoni ngeentshulube zeebhokhwe?
options: Qhubeka nohlolo lwempilo nesicwangciso se-parasite esivunyelwene nomcebisi wempilo yezilwanyana
Yeka zonke iindlela zokuhlola iintshulube ngenxa yokuba iinkukhu bezikho
Cinga ukuba ubulongwe beenkukhu bubulala onke amaqanda eentshulube
Cinga ukuba ukushukumisa umhlambi kuhlala kwenza unyango lungabi nasidingo
quiz.rationale: Iinkukhu azizondlela eqinisekisiweyo yokuthatha indawo yokulawula iintshulube zeebhokhwe. Ulawulo lokulisa nohlolo lwempilo yezilwanyana kufuneka kusebenzisane.

lessons.infographicAlt: Ukutya okuthengiweyo kungena kwifama. Izilwanyana zivelisa ubulongwe, ezinye izondlo zibuyela kwindawo yokutyala ngobulongwe obuvunde ngokupheleleyo, kwaye ukutya nezinye iimveliso ziphuma kwifama.
